headline: Weathered Expanse Swings Back as Stlican Shelf Fighting Rekindles
war_summary: Since our last edition, the tide in Weathered Expanse has turned once more. Where the Warden line lately led five posts to four, the Colonials have reclaimed the balance and now count six of nine, with forty base actions logged in a day — Crow's Nest and Frostmarch busiest — and the latest exchange recorded as this dispatch went to press. Stlican Shelf, still warm from its last clash at Fort Hoarfrost, leans Colonial five posts to four, its casualty tallies climbing hour over hour. Mooring County holds eleven Warden posts of twelve, though Gravekeeper's Holdfast's fourteen-event day has since gone quiet. On the Nevish Line the guns have sharpened anew, losses mounting by the hour about Grief Mother, which the Colonials now hold. Palantine Berm stays five-two Warden, Leiri Hermanni its busiest ground. Callahan's Passage changed no hands yet counted better than eight thousand Colonial and seven thousand Warden casualties in a day. Elsewhere the fronts rest. It is day 371; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
